title: WizCommerce - Custom sender domain costs extra, not included by default
clean_text: WizCommerce's base plan does not include sending order emails from the customer's own domain; enabling a custom sender address requires an additional monthly fee. A reviewer noted this cost was unanticipated and questioned whether business customers would accept tradeshow orders arriving from a WizCommerce-branded email address, suggesting the feature should be included by default rather than charged separately.
